detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A cozy adventure of rebuilding, exploration, and bringing a forgotten village back to life. 🌿

After a powerful tornado tears through the land, homes lie in ruins and villagers are separated from their precious belongings. Explore nearby mazes of winding paths and hidden routes, recover what was lost, and help restore the village one step at a time.

Explore Charming Worlds ⭐

Travel through peaceful forests, snowy paths, forgotten ruins, and cozy hidden areas filled with small stories and secrets. Every region holds lost items, friendly creatures, tiny critters, and small moments waiting to be discovered.

  • ✏️ Fill your journal map as you journey through the world

  • 🧩 Solve cozy puzzles using levers, lights, weights, portals, rotating paths and more.

  • 🐾 Discover and catch adorable critters

  • 🎣 Enjoy fishing, wandering, and relaxed exploration

Restore & Customize Your Village 🏘️

Bring life back to the village by rebuilding homes, decorating freely, and shaping the town into your own creation. Every recovered item and restored house helps the community grow again.

  • 🍃 Decorate interiors and outdoor spaces

  • 🧱 Edit tiles and paths to design your village layout

  • 🛒 Visit shops and collect furniture, decorations, and more

  • 🏠 Restore homes and welcome villagers back

A Living World Full of Cozy Moments 🌸

Mazey Village is filled with small, heartwarming interactions that make the world feel alive again. Slow down, explore at your own pace, and enjoy the little moments along the way.

  • 🐈 Pet animals and meet friendly creatures

  • 💬 Talk with villagers and discover their stories

  • 👒 Dress up your character with cozy outfits

  • ✨ Watch the village slowly come back to life

Are you ready to begin your journey? The village is waiting for you!
